svg.title: Port crane operator — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as port crane operator, wearing a safety vest and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A horizontal ribbed shipping container hangs level from two slings beneath a broad crane spreader. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
